scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && set DEV_MODE=true && python uvicorn_config.py
scripts.dev:backend:fast: cd backend && python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --log-level warning
scripts.start: cd backend && set DEV_MODE=false && python uvicorn_config.py
scripts.start:prod: cd backend && set DEV_MODE=false && python uvicorn_config.py
scripts.clean: cd frontend && rimraf node_modules/.vite && rimraf dist
scripts.clean:all: cd frontend && rimraf node_modules && npm install
scripts.fresh: npm run clean && npm run dev:all
scripts.fresh:full: npm run clean:all && npm run dev:all
